Basic embedding request for a single input string

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final req = await createEmbeddingRequestFromJson(json: '{"input":"Hello world","model":"text-embedding-3-small"}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.embed(req: req);
    stdout.writeln(result.data);
    stdout.writeln(result.data[0].embedding);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
